basicInfo.name: Hayeon
basicInfo.flavor: Hayeon's noble and selfless sacrifice had sealed the rift, fulfilling the Night Elves' long-cherished wish. With no further need to guard the breach in the darkness, she became known as the \"Final Priestess\" who brought a long and storied era to an end.

Normal Attack.desc:
2 Enemies
 - Deals damage equal to 70% of Magic Attack 1 time(s).
 - 40% chance to inflict Bleed [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 70% of Physical Attack.

Skill 1.desc:
All Enemies
 - 100% chance to inflict 2 Buff Removal(s).
 - 75% chance to inflict a stack of Bleed for each buff removed. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - 100% chance to inflict a 2 turn Debuff Duration Boost on the target.
 - 55% chance to inflict Paralysis. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Deals damage equal to 60% of Magic Attack 1 time(s).
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 60% of Physical Attack.

Skill 2.desc:
All Allies
 - Grants 2 Debuff Removal(s).
 - Grants Continuous Healing for each debuff removed. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
 - Grants a Buff Duration Boost of 2 turn(s).
 - Grants All Damage Immunity. [Duration: 1 Turn(s)]

Passive.desc:
Self
 - Grants Ally Role Support. [Always Active]
 - 63% chance to perform a Cover. [Always Active]
 - Grants Guts. [Once per Battle]
 - Grants a Barrier equal to 135% of the caster's Magic Attack upon triggering Guts. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
 - Awakening Gauge Boost increases to 11 when an ally falls in battle.
 - Awakening Gauge Boost increases to 11 when an enemy falls in battle.
 - Enemy with the highest current HP
 - Grants HP Swap upon triggering Guts.
 - Inflicts Unable to Recover upon triggering Guts. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Inflicts Buff Block upon triggering Guts. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - All Allies
 - Heals HP equal to 22% of the caster's Max HP when HP falls to 50% or lower. [1 Time(s) per Battle]
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - All Allies
 - Adds Effect: Barrier equal to 25% of the caster's Max HP when HP falls to 50% or lower. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)] [Once per Battle]
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Enemies (Attack, Magic)
 - Adds Effect: 22% All Attack Reduction. [Always Active]
 - Enemies (Defense, Support, Universal)
 - Adds Effect: 24% Defense Reduction. [Always Active]

Awaken Skill.name: Gate of Heavenly Mandate
Awaken Skill.desc:
All Allies
 - Reduces skill cooldowns by 20s.
 - Grants a Barrier equal to 30% of the caster's Max HP. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
 - All Enemies
 - 100% chance to inflict Skill Cooldown Increase. [Increased by: 24s]
 - 100% chance to inflict Buff Block. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - All Allies
 - Adds Effect: Grants a Barrier equal to 30% of the caster's Max HP. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
